content: For unified git diff parsing in Go, use bluekeyes/go-gitdiff (v0.8.1, Jan 2025) which handles binary diffs, renames, extended headers, and file status tracking (IsNew, IsDelete, IsRename, IsCopy). It parses the FileDiff/TextFragment/BinaryFragment structure from git diff output. For intra-line character-level highlighting of changed words, combine with sergi/go-diff (v1.4.0, Jun 2025) which provides DiffMain(text1, text2, checklines) returning []Diff with DiffDelete/DiffInsert/DiffEqual operations. sourcegraph/go-diff (v0.8.0) is an alternative unified diff parser but lacks binary/rename edge case handling that go-gitdiff provides.
